exact_quote.text:
1.  ON APRIL 12, DEPTOFF (PRECHT) MET WITH MEHDI HAERI-YAZDI
WHO HAS BEEN APPOINTED AS PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE OF
KHOMEINI AND SANJABI IN THE U.S.

qualification_paragraph.text:
1.  ON APRIL 12, DEPTOFF (PRECHT) MET WITH MEHDI HAERI-YAZDI
WHO HAS BEEN APPOINTED AS PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE OF
KHOMEINI AND SANJABI IN THE U.S.  HAERI, A VISITING SCHOLAR
OF ISLAMIC PHILOSOPHY AT GEORGETOWN UNIVERSITY, WAS A LONG-
TIME STUDENT OF KHOMEINI AND HAERI'S FATHER WAS KHOMEINI'S
TEACHER.  HAERI APPARENTLY KNEW SANJABI AT TEHRAN UNIVERSI-
TY.  SANJABI, IT APPEARS, ARRANGED HAERI APPOINTMENT IN
ORDER TO ECLIPSE ROUHANI; AT SAME TIME SANJABI ASSIGNED A
STRONGER DIPLOMAT, HASSAN ETESSAM, AS CHARGE.  ETESSAM HAS
RETURNED TO TEHRAN, ACCORDING TO EMBASSY OFFICERS, IN DIS-
GUST AT CONTINUING CONFUSION HERE.  HE MAY REMAIN THERE.
2.  HAERI TOLD US HE HAD RECENTLY TELEPHONED AND CABLED
TEHRAN TO REPORT THAT SITUATION AT THE EMBASSY WAS INTOL-
ERABLE AND DAMAGING TO IRAN'S INTERESTS.  HE HIMSELF COULD
NOT CONTINUE TO SERVE KHOMEINI AND PGOI UNDER THESE CIRCUM-
STANCES.  HE HAD TOLD "TEHRAN" THAT KHOMEINI, BAZARGAN AND
SANJABI, ACTING LONE AND WITHOUT ANY OTHER ADVICE (READ
FROM YAZDI), SHOULD SELECT ONE MAN TO SERVE AS AMBASSADOR.
AMBASSADOR MEYER, WHO ARRANGED MEETING, SUGGESTED HAERI
MIGHT BE THE MAN.  HAERI DID NOT DEMUR BUT FROM OTHER
REMARKS HE CLEARLY PREFERS SCHOLARLY PURSUITS.
3.  HAERI IS A STRONG SUPPORTER OF BAZARGAN, SEEING HIM AS
VIRTUALLY INDISPENSIBLE IN THE PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES.  HE
BELIEVES THAT KHOMEINI'S THOUGHTS ARE BEING MISINTERPRETED
BY THOSE AROUND HIM WITH UNFORTUNATE RESULTS.  HAERI SAID
HE (HAERI) WAS "100 PER CENT OPPOSED" TO SYSTEM OF SUMMARY
TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS.           -      - -
4.  DEPTOFF REITERATED POINTS MADE BY THE SECRETARYTO
CHARGE ETESSAM CONCERNING OUR DESIRE FOR NORMAL, COOPERA-
TIVE RELATIONS WITH IRAN AND OUR RECOGNITION OF NEEDTO
PROCEED CAUTIOUSLY IN ESTABLISHING NEW TIES.  HAERI SAID
HE WAS CONFIDENT PGOI LEADERSHIP ALSO WISHEDTO MAKE A NEW
BEGINNING.  THERE WAS A LOT OF HISTORY TO OVERCOME, BUT HE
THOUGHT KHOMEINI HELD NO GRUDGE AGAINST PRESENT ADMINISTRA-
TION.  BOTH SIDES SHOULD MOVE GRADUALLY TOWARDS NORMALIZA-
TION, BUT IT WAS IMPORTANT TO BEAR IN MIND THAT THERE WAS
A "FEVER" STILL RUNNING IN IRAN.
5.  HAERI SAID HE PLANNED TENTATIVELY TO VISIT IRAN TOWARDS
EARLY MAY IN ORDER TO DISCUSS FRANKLY WITH KHOMEINI HARD
REALITIES FACING NEW GOVERNMENT.  HE WAS PARTICULARLY
CONCERNED ABOUT ECONOMIC SITUATION AND THE EFFECT TRIALS
AND EXECUTIONS WERE HAVING ON NATIONAL REPUTATION AND
FOREIGN RELATIONS.
6.  HAERI IS A SOFT SPOKEN, INTELLIGENT PERSON WITH A
SCHOLAR'S INCLINATION TO DIGRESS AND DEVELOP THEORETICAL
POINTS.  HE IS, HOWEVER, KEENLY ALERT TO POLITICAL DEVELOP-
MENTS, VERY LOYAL TO KHOMEINI/BAZARGAN GROUP, HOSTILE TO
THE SHAH'S REGIME AND ITS SUPPORTERS, SEEMINGLY A PROGRES-
SIVE AND PRAGMATIST IN HIS RELIGIOUS ORIENTATION, BUT NOT
AT ALL CUT OUT TO DIRECT THE WORK OF THE IRANIAN EMBASSY.
WE HAVE HEARD OF SEVERAL DECISIONS WHICH HAVE BEEN RE-
FERRED TO HIM AND WHICH ARE STILL PENDING.   CHRISTOPHER

2. SUMMARY: SHARIAT-MADARI WANTS BROADER BALLOT IN REFERENDUM.

DANGERS OF WEAK GOVERNMENT. ETHNIC TURKOMANS DEMAND MORE
RECOGNITION. JUSTICE IN TODAY'S IRAN: ARRESTS AND EXECUTIONS
CONTINUE. JAMES BILL STATEMENTS ON "PRO-U.S." AIDES IN THE
BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. END SUMMARY.

THE BALLOT QUESTION FOR THE COMING REFERENDUM SHOULD BE
PHRASED TO ALLOW MORE CHOICE OF A FORM OF GOVERNMENT. HE
CLAIMS THAT THE OVERWHELMING RESULT WOULD STILL BE AN ISLAMIC
REPUBLIC, BUT THAT DOUBT OVER THE FREEDOM OF THE ELECTION
WOULD BE ELIMINATED. IN OTHER REFERENDUM NEWS, PERSIAN PRESS
GAVE WIDE COVERAGE TO A STATEMENT BY DR. MUFTEH (DESCRIBED
AS A MEMBER OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE) THAT THE BALLOT
WILL ALLOW A CHOICE AMONG SEVERAL TYPES OF GOVERNMENTS.
ACCORDING TO
DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM, HOWEVER, THE
GOVERNMENT STILL PLANS TO USE SINGLE QUESTION BALLOTS IN
RED AND GREEN COLORS.
4. WOMEN'S DEMONSTRATIONS WILL CONTINUE TODAY, AND THE PRESS
GIVES WIDE COVERAGE TO THE "CHADOR OR NO CHADOR" ISSUE AS AN
EXPRESSION OF THE WHOLE STATUS OF WOMEN UNDER THE PROPOSED
ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. TODAY'S MARCH WILL START AT THE UNIVERSITY
AND PROCEED TO FREEDOM CIRCLE (FORMERLY SHAYAD CIRCLE) AND
MALE "LEFTIST" GROUPS ARE EXPECTED TO ACCOMPANY THE WOMEN.
ABADAN AND TABRIZ HAVE ALSO REPORTED DEMONSTRATIONS AND PRO-
TESTS AGAINST THE IMPOSITION OF THE "ISLAMIC"DRESS CODE.
5. THE PEOPLE'S FEDAYEEN ORGANIZATION HAS ANNOUNCED ITS
WILLINGNESS TO COOPERATE WITH THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT, BUT
ALSO WARNED THAT UNLESS THE GOVERNMENT ASSERTED ITS AUTHORITY AS
SOON AS POSSIBLE, THERE WAS DANGER OF INCREASED VIOLENCE AND
"UNWANTED CIVIL WAR".
6. CLASHES ERUPTED IN BANDAR SHAH ON THE CASPIAN AND TWELVE
PERSONS WERE REPORTED WOUNDED AS A GROUP OF REPORTEDLY FIFTEEN
THOUSAND ETHNIC TURKOMANS TRIED TO CHANGE THE NAME OF THE CITY
TO BANDAR TURKOMAN AND WERE MET BY A RIVAL GROUP TRYING TO
CHANGE IT TO BANDAR ISLAM. BESIDES THE CITY NAME CHANGE PRO-
POSAL, THE TURKOMAN (PREDOMINATELY SUNNI) GROUP IS ALSO
DEMANDING MORE AUTONOMY AND RECOGNITION OF THEIR TURKOMAN
LANGUAGE IN THE SCHOOL SYSTEM.
7. ARRESTS AND EXECUTIONS CONTINUE THROUGHOUT IRAN AND
YESTERDAY'S OFFICIAL COUNT WAS SIX KILLED BY FIRING SQUADS.
BESIDES THOSE FOR POLICE, GENDARMERIE AND OTHER OFFICIALS
BEING SENTENCED TO DEATH FOR "ANTI-REVOLUTION" ACTS (I.E.,
SHOOTING DEMONSTRATORS DURING EARLIER ANTI-SHAH PROTESTS), A
NUMBER OF DEATH SENTENCES HAVE BEEN PASSED ON "SEXUAL" OFFENDERS.
GIVEN PRESENT SITUATION, WHERE "COMMITTEE" GROUPS STILL WIELD
THE POWER TO MAKE ARRESTS AND TRY ALLEGED OFFENDERS, WHERE
THE CIVIL POLICE ORGANIZATION IS STILL IN A SHAMBLES, AND
WHERE THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE IS BEING THOROUGHLY REORGANIZED,
THERE IS NO CONSISTENCY IN IMPOSITION OF PENALTIES. MANY
AREAS ARE ADJUDICATING CASES ON THE BASIS OF "ISLAMIC" LAW,
AND SENTENCES PASSED SEEM TO DEPEND ON THE LOCAL LEVEL OF
FANATICISM. IN ASTARA TWO YOUTHS HAVE BEEN SENTENCED TO
DEATH FOR RAPING A YOUNG GIRL, AND ONE OF THEM HAS BEEN
CONDEMNED TO DEATH BY STONING. IN SHAHRE-KORD, ONE MAN WAS
FORCED TO MARRY A PROSTITUTE HE HAD JUST HIRED, AND SEVEN OTHERS
ACCUSED OF GAMBLING WERE PUBLICLY WHIPPED. PUBLIC FLOGGINGS
FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL HAVE BEEN REPORTED FROM VARIOUS PARTS
OF THE COUNTRY. THERE HAVE ALSO BEEN REPORTS OF AUTHORITIES
REFUSING TO LET FAMILY MEMBERS VISIT THOSE ACCUSED OF CRIMES.
AMONG MANY PEOPLE THERE IS A GROWING OPINION THAT EXECUTIONS
ARE REALLY FAR MORE WIDESPREAD THAN THE PAPERS REPORT.
8.BOTH PERSIAN AND ENGLISH PRESS REPORTED ON JAMES BILL'S
COMMENTS IN "TIME" THAT THERE WERE SEVERAL "PRO-US" AIDES IN
THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT. AT A TIME WHEN OVERT ASSOCIATION
WITH EITHER THE EMBASSY OR THE AMERICAN GOVERNMENT AS A WHOLE
IS CONSIDERED BY MANY IRANIANS TO BE THE EQUIVALENT OF LEPROSY,
THE DESCRIPTION OF YAZDI AS "PRO-AMERICAN" AND EXTEZAM AS
"ABOUT AS AMERICAN AS YOU CAN POSSIBLY GET" ARE NOT EXPECTED
TO HELP THOSE GENTLEMEN.
SULLIVAN

qualification_paragraph.text:
AFFAIRS
1.  (C-ENTIRE TEXT)  THIS IS A REPORTING CABLE.
2.  SUMMARY:  BEHESHTI SAYS IRANIAN REVOLUTION IS NOT
FINISHED, REVOLUTIONARY COURTS ARE ONLY TEMPORARY.
AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI TO REPLACE MOTAHARI ON REVOLUTIONARY
COUNCIL.  YAZDI HAS LOST STEAM.  IN FOREIGN POLICY,
BEHESHI SAYS ISLAMIC REVOLUTION WANTS EVEN-HANDED NON-
INTERVENTION FROM BIG POWERS.  END SUMMARY.
3.  IN PROCESS OF TRYING TO SET UP MEETING WITH AYATOLLAH
BEHESHTI, ACTING POL COUNS WAS ASKED TO SUBMIT LIST
OF QUESTIONS FOR DISCUSSION.  BEHESHTI BEGGED OFF
MEETING, BUT GAVE WRITTEN ANSWERS BACK THROUGH OUR
SOURCE, LONG-TIME KHOMEINI ASSOCIATE WHO WAS ACTING
AS INTERMEDIARY.  BEHESHTI'S COMMENTS ARE OF MORE
THAN PASSING INTEREST, BECAUSE HE IS REPORTED TO BE
HEAD OF REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, WHICH IS CONSIDERED TOP
RLLING ORGAN OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTION.  INTERMEDIARY, WHOSE
CONTACTS WITHIN KHOMEINI MOVEMENT ARE IMPECCABLE, SAID
BEHESHTI IS NOW MAIN GO-BETWEEN IN PROVISIONAL
GOVERNMENT OF IRAN (PGOI)-- KHOMEINI RELATIONSHIP
AND IS THUS MAN CHARGED WITH HARMONIZING RELATIONSHIPS
BETWEEN PGOI AND COMMITTEE STRUCTURE.  INTERMEDIARY
CONFIRMED THA1 AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI WILL REPLACE
ASSASSINATED AYATOLLAH MOTAHARI ON THE REVOLUTIONARY
COUNCIL, AND SAID THIS WAS GOOD, BECAUSE IN TERMS OF
RELATIONSHIPS AMONG AYATOLLAHS, MONTAZERI WAS PROBABLY
MAN NEXT IN LINE TO TAKE KHOMEINI'S PLACE IN EVENT OF
LATTER'S DEATH.  WHEN ASKED WHY MANTLE WOULD NOT FALL
TO SHARIATMADARI, SOURCE SAID HE IS NOT OF SAME
IDEOLOGICAL SCHOOL AS KHOMEINI, AND ISLAMIC MOVEMENT
LEADERSHIP WOULD NOT ALLOW HIM TO TAKE POSITION; MONTAZERI
WAS BEST OF REST, AND MOST RESPECTED.
4.  RESPONDING TO QUESTION OF WHAT WERE REVOLUTIONARY
GOALS, AND WHERE WAS REVOLUTION HEADED, BEHESHTI COMMENTED
AS FOLLOWS:  QUOTE OUR AIM IS TO CREATE  HEALTHY ORDER
AND HEALTHY RELATIONS BOTH INSIDE IRAN AND WITH OUTSIDE
WORLD.  UNQUOTE.  REVOLUTION IS QUOTE TRYING HARD
TO KEEP ITS DIRECTION, BUT HAS NOT YET REACHED ITS
GOALS END QUOTE.  BY NATURE, QUOTE IRAN WANTS TO HAVE
HEALTHY HUMAN TIES WITH ALL PEOPLES ON THE CONDITION THAT
FOREIGNERS RESPECT IDEA OF FAIR HUMAN RELATIONS. END QUOTE.
5.  ON REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL: QUOTE IT IS LIKE TWO
HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT ROLLED INTO ONE. UNQUOTE.  IT
HAS SUPREME LEGISLATIVE AUTHORITY AND MONITORS THE
EXECUTIVE BRANCH.  ON QUESTION OF WHO WAS ON COUNCIL,
BEHESHTI SAID QUOTE IF WE WANTED IT KNOWN, WE WOULD HAVE
ANNOUNCED IT. END QUOTE.
6.  ON REVOLUTIONARY ISLAMIC COURTS:  REVOLUTIONARY
COURTS QUOTE ARE FUNCTIONING TO PUNISH ENEMIES OF THE
PEOPLE IN THE PAST AND PEOPLE WHO ARE PRESENTLY ANTI-
REVOLUTIONARY.  THESE ARE NOT NORMAL COURTS, THEY ARE
REVOLUTIONARY COURTS; THEIR ACTION WILL BE TEMPORARY,
AFTER WHICH THE JOB WILL BE TURNED OVER TO THE CIVILIAN
COURTS.  END QUOTE.  BEHESHTI REFUSED TO COMMENT ON TIME
THIS WOULD HAPPEN, BUT INTERMEDIARY SAID HE THOUGHT
PGOI'S PUBLICLY ANNOUNCED TIME OF ONE YEAR WAS CURRENT
WORKING TIME FRAME.  SOURCE, WHO STRONGLY DISAPPROVES
OF SUMMARY EXECUTIONS, WAS FEARFUL THAT THERE WOULD BE
MORE.  (COMMENT:  BEHESHTI'S STRESS ON COURT'S ROLE IN
DEALING WITH PRESENT REVOLUTIONAIRES HAD BEEN REFLECTED
IN OTHER COMMENT ON COURTS, ESPECIALLY SINCE SECOND
ASSASSINATION OF ISLAMIC MOVEMENT LEADER MOTAHARI.)
BEHESHTI MADE POINT AT END OF HIS ANSWERS THAT REVOLUTION
HAS NOT BEEN BLOODY, BUT QUOTE IF THE REVOLUTION IS
NOT BLOODY, THAT DOES NOT MEAN WE HAVE NOT HAD A THOROUGH
REVOLUTION.  IF THERE HAD BEEN NO REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL
ALL PRISONERS NOW IN JAIL WOULD HAVE ALREADY BEEN KILLED
BY THE PEOPLE.  END QUOTE.  (COMMENT:  HE MADE THIS
POINT IN CONTEXT OF JUSTIFICATION FOR REVOLUTIONARY
TRIALS.)
7.  ON FOREIGN RELATIONS:  BEHESHTI SIAD QUOTE IRAN WANTS
THE OUTSIDE WORLD NOT RPT NOT TO ASSIST ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY
FORCES AND NOT TO INTERFERE WITH IRANIAN AFFAIRS.  WE ARE
NOT ASKING ANYTHING MORE, FROM EITHER THE U.S. OR THE
U.S.S.R.  OUR RELATIONS WITH THE USSR SHOULD BE LIKE
TWO NORMAL NEIGHBORS.  THEY MUST NOT INTERFERE AND THEY
MUST NOT ASK SPECIAL FAVORS FROM US.  END QUOTE.  RE U.S.,
BEHESHTI WENT ON, QUOTE THE GOVERNMENT OF THE U.S. HAS

2.  SUMMARY:  CHARGE DISCUSSED WITH MINISTER SAHABI U.S.-

UNDERSTANDINGS WOULD NOT IMPEDE GOOD TIES WHICH PGOI
WANTS.  SAHABI TALKED OF NEW GOVERNMENT STRUCTURE AND
SHOWED ACTIVE INTEREST IN FEDERAL SYSTEM.  BIO NOTE.
END SUMMARY.
3.  CHARGE AND ACTING POLCOUNS CALLED ON MINISTER OF
STATE FOR REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS DR. YADOLLAH SAHABI
MORNING MAY 20.  SAHABI RECEIVED AMERICANS IN PLEASANT,
GRACEFUL OLD-WORLD PERSIAN MANNER AND DISCUSSION WAS
FRIENDLY THROUGHOUT.  FOLLOWING ARE IMPORTANT POINTS:
4.  AFTER CHARGE EXPRESSED U.S. INTEREST IN GOOD TIES
WITH NEW PGOI AND ASSURED MINISTER THAT USG WAS NOT RPT
NOT INTERFERING IN IRAN AND WOULD NOT DO SO, SAHABI
IMMEDIATELY AND IN AN UNDERSTANDING MANNER EXPRESSED
REGRETS FOR MEDIA ATTACKS ON USG IN WAKE OF PUBLICITY
GIVEN JAVITS RESOLUTION ON IRAN.  SAHABI SAID IRAN IS IN
REVOLUTIONARY PERIOD AND AFFIRMED TWICE THAT BAZARGAN
GOVERNMENT WANTS GOOD RELATIONS WITH U.S.  HE NOTED,
HOWEVER, THAT THERE ARE MANY QUESTIONS WHICH MUST BE
RESOLVED BETWEEN IRAN AND U.S. AND REGRETTED VERY MUCH
THAT QUOTE MISUNDERSTANDINGS UNQUOTE WERE MARRING PUBLIC
SCENE.  FONMIN WOULD BE CALLING TO TALK TO CHARGE ABOUT
PROBLEM (YAZDI DID CALL; SEE SEPTEL ON LATER MEETING).
HE SAID THAT MUCH OF WHAT WAS IN RESOLUTION WAS TRUE;
SOME OF WHAT PRESS IN IRAN WAS SAYING IS TRUE.  IRAN IS
IN A REVOLUTIONARY SITUATION--EVEN QUESTION AS SIMPLE AS
THAT OF NEW PASSPORTS IS NOT RESOLVED YET.  ROLE OF REVO-
LUTIONARY COURTS, MASS DEMONSTRATIONS AND VARIOUS MOVE-
MENTS ARE ALL CHANGING.  IRAN'S PROBLEMS WILL BE WORKED
OUT, BUT IT WILL TAKE TIME.  CHARGE COMMENTED THAT EXE-
CUTIONS AND TRIALS WITHOUT INTERNATIONALLY ACCEPTED
STANDARDS CAUSED U.S. AND OTHERS TO THINK MORE BADLY OF
THE REVOLUTION THAN THEY WOULD OTHERWISE.  WITH OBVIOUS
PAIN IN HIS BROW, SAHABI SAID QUOTE YOU ARE RIGHT; WE ARE
NOT HAPPY WITH THESE EXECUTIONS OURSELVES.  BUT WHAT CAN
YOU EXPECT?  IF THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT DOES NOT STAY IN
OFFICE, THERE WILL BE NO HOPE FOR STABILITY. END QUOTE.
(COMMENT:  WE THINK HE IS PROBABLY RIGHT.)  SAHABI SAID
COURTS WERE A SHORT TERM EXPEDIENT WHICH WOULD NOT LAST;
PGOI WANTED TO WIND THEM UP AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, BUT IT
WOULD TAKE A LITTLE TIME.
5.  CHARGE ASKED ABOUT NEW GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE.  SAHABI
REPLIED THAT DRAFT CONSTITUTION WOULD BE RELEASED WITHIN
TWO WEEKS.  CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY WOULD BE CALLED WITH-
IN 30 TO 60 DAYS.  PGOI EXPECTED ASSEMBLY TO LAST A
MAXIMUM OF FOUR MONTHS, WITH ELECTIONS FOR PRESIDENT AND
THE PARLIAMENT TO FOLLOW TOWARD THE END OF THIS YEAR.
WITH RESPECT TO RELATIONSHIP OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS TO
NEW GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE, SAHABI SAID THIS CONFUSES
EVEN MEMBERS OF GOVERNMENT.  FOR NOW, DR. MUSTAFA
CHAMRAN IS THE HEAD OF THE GUARDS, BUT HE IS NOT RPT NOT
A DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER.  DEPUTY PM BANI-ASSADI HAS NO
RPT NO CONNECTION WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS.
6.  SAHABI SAID HIS OWN OFFICE, THE BUREAU OF REVOLUTIONARY
AFFAIRS, WILL BE IN CHARGE OF REVIEWING ALL LAWS AND
HARMONIZING THEM WITH THE NEW GOVERNMENTAL SYSTEM.  IN
THIS CONNECTION, HE THANKED ACTING POLCOUNS FOR SENDING
HIM A COPY OF THE U.S. FEDERAL CONSTITUTION.  AFTER DIS-
CUSSION OF FEDERAL SYSTEM, INCLUDING DUAL LINES OF GOVERN-
MENT AND STATE AND FEDERAL TAX STRUCTURES, SAHABI SAID
THAT IF WE HAD ANY MORE MATERIAL ON U.S. FEDERAL STRUCTURE,
HE WOULD LIKE TO HAVE IT.  PGOI PLANNED TO REMAKE IRAN INTO
FEDERATED SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT TO HELP EASE TRIBAL AND
OTHER PROBLEMS OF DECENTRALIZATION.  CHARGE SAID USG WOULD
BE HAPPY TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL INFO (SEE SEPTEL).
7.  BIO NOTE:  SAHABI IS IN HIS 80'S AND A CLOSE, LONG-
TIME FRIEND OF PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN.  OTHERS WHO HAVE
SEEN HIM HAVE NOT BEEN IMPRESSED WITH HIS GRASP OF PROBLEMS
AND COHERENCE, BUT DURING THIS MEETING HE EXHIBITED SO-
PHISTICATED VIEW OF IRAN'S PROBLEMS AND POTENTIAL AND RE-
MAINED ALERT THROUGHOUT.  HE HAS NO INDEPENDENT POWER
BASE, HOWEVER, AND MUST BE COUNTED AMONG THE PGOI'S
SECULARISTS.  HIS REACTION TO QUESTIONS ABOUT THE REVOLU-
TIONARY COURTS AND U.S.-IRAN RELATIONS MADE IT CRYSTAL
CLEAR HE LACKS SYMPATHY FOR THE KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE.  HE
IS OBVIOUSLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE PROBLEM OF INSTITUTIONAL-
IZING THE GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE, AND SPOKE FORCEFULLY ON
THE NEED TO GET A NEW GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE IN PLACE.
HE IS ONE OF THE REVOLUTION'S ELDER STATESMEN. NAAS
